latestVersion.changelog:
gate-exchange-autoinvest v1.0.0

- Initial release of Gate Exchange's fast auto-invest (DCA) skill, supporting creation, update, stop, and top-up invest plans.
- Enables queries for supported coins, minimum/maximum investment amounts, execution records, plan details, and orders.
- Enforces investment rules: only USDT/BTC as funding currency, strict time zone handling (UTC for execution hours), target coin allocation limits, and validation of amount and allocation ranges.
- Privacy and risk disclaimers are presented for transparency in data handling and investment risks.
- Integrates with a defined set of MCP tools for all auto-invest management and queries.
